notes.title: Update No.1 Preview & Future Roadmap
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! Mark your calendars for [b]August 4th[/b] - The Netherworld Covenant is set to release its [b]first major update[/b] since Early Access launch! Below is a preview of the new content. The detailed update log will be shared on release day:[/p][list][*][p]New Chapter: Chapter V - Ruins[/p][/*][*][p]New Bosses: Chaos Before Creation, Burning Bone Demon Ursok, Siren Nera[/p][/*][*][p]New Mechanic: Resonance Auras (provides base effects and expands in-run aura choices)[/p][/*][*][p]New Relics: 40[/p][/*][*][p]New Accessories: 3[/p][/*][*][p]Aura Adjustments: 50+[/p][/*][*][p]Several Optimizations & Bug Fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/cbb716cf4fd0cff38c8ded9f02ecf1c1d4328191.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Since the Early Access launch, our team has received an overwhelming amount of feedback and suggestions from players worldwide. After carefully considering these inputs and reflecting deeply on the current version, we’ve decided to adjust our development roadmap to better align with everyone’s expectations.[/p][p][/p][p]First, regarding combat accessibility, weapons, and playstyle diversity: We will introduce a new "[b]Class System[/b]". Players will be able to directly switch between characters with distinct appearances - each featuring completely unique attack modules, combat approaches, and stat distributions. Below are some previews of characters currently in development:[/p][p][/p][p]Mage:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/5a4949b25e7612a07068721c53c6a52ac112f41c.gif"][/img][/p][p]Berserker:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/c1f2f10fb264efb88676f327dc2d9604f713666f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Archer:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/b821370500170517c8e6e7a6a8e66b561eb72361.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re targeting [b]Update No.2 for the initial release of the Class System[/b], with additional character classes to be added in subsequent updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Next is the difficulty level: Difficulty 3 is currently in development, offering players a fresh challenge. After that, we will also create a challenge mode similar to the "heat system" in Hades, using more debuff options to further increase the difficulty. Plus, the design of some hidden bosses is also currently under evaluation.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/01b206c9294079ad387c4aeaf9647e047873d675.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In addition, a "Boss Rush Mode" is also in the works, with the aim of enriching the content while satisfying the expectations of players who enjoy Boss Rush or prefer the ARPG aspects of the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.6.10.1
notes.notes:
After the release of v0.6.10.0, many players reported stability issues. As a result, we reverted to the more stable v0.6.9 last week and resolved multiple bugs causing instability. We are now relaunching the v0.6.10 content. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused.

Additionally: The demo version has been synchronized with the latest content.

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.6.9.1
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an issue where players could infinitely claim resources from the "Cursed Chest".
2. Fixed crashes occurring in certain edge cases.

[b]FAQ: Suddenly can't access my save file / Black screen with continuous loading[/b]
You can try "Verifying the Integrity of Game Files" in the game properties to resolve the issue. The specific steps are:
Game Library → Game Properties → Installed Files → Verify Integrity of Game Files → All files successfully validated.

notes.title: Patch Notes v.0.6.9
notes.notes:
1. Fixed an issue where enemies could be stunned while in Super Armor/Endure state.
2. Rolling outside of combat no longer consumes Stamina.
3. Reduced enemy attack power in Easy Mode.
4. Increased minion HP in Chapters 3 & 4 of Normal Mode. (Note: This actually was a configuration error in the launching version. We apologize for any inconvenience.)
5. Optimized the HP display; the low HP warning is now more prominent/noticeable.
6. Added functionality where Boss voice lines are now affected by the Volume Settings.
7. Fixed several game logic errors.
8. Optimized the visual effects for enemies in the Super Armor/Endure state(Body lights up in yellow when triggering).

Additionally, the official team plans to release bundles simultaneously with games like Magicraft. Players purchasing bundles will receive an extra 10% discount on top of the base game discount.[/p][p][/p][p]As a 3D top-down action roguelike with a Souls-like feel, the game's hardcore combat, excellent hit feedback, and rich combat systems have garnered positive feedback from many global players since the demo release. Players will encounter numerous combat encounters and resource management decisions during battle. Effectively managing energy and stamina, and choosing different builds based on personal playstyle, are essential skills players must master.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The content included in this Early Access (EA) release consists of:[/b][/p][list][*][p]4 complete chapter scenarios, 15 unique Boss battles;[/p][/*][*][p]9 main weapon types, 4 Nether Lantern weapons, 20+ Soul Skills, 30+ accessories;[/p][/*][*][p]5 types of protagonist auras, 4 types of ghost auras, 20+ meta-progression options;[/p][/*][*][p]Random elements like relics and events and etc.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Furthermore, the game plans to maintain a stable update frequency post-EA launch. Confirmed upcoming updates include:[/b][/p][list][*][p]July: Chapter 5, more random events & challenges, more relic choices.[/p][/*][*][p]August-September: New difficulty levels, new gameplay modes, Soul Skill variations, the final challenge, etc.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/6ccabb7bc7a476b1b40a52c0d54540a166e25506.png"][/img][/p][p]During the launch period, we will hold interesting community events like speedrun competitions and share-and-win raffles with decent prizes. Please join our [url="https://discord.gg/4ZwXCYS4ed"]Discord[/url] to find more details.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/8511aa9c4c805bbf3f3479bcaee276dc0b45c4a6.png"][/img][/p][p]Moreover, we have collected many players' questions before the launch and prepared an [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2735580/discussions/0/595152144826392997/"]FAQ section[/url] here to help everyone better understand the game. notes.title: Netherworld Covenant Launch Early Access on June 19th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/1c12942c0d2c52bae44fa1b4eb9b1af4ee4cd97a.jpg[/img]
Netherworld Covenant will globally release in Early Access on June 19, 2025. Developed by the Chinese two-person team MadGoat Game Studio and published by Infini Fun, this dark 3D action roguelike is ready to meet players worldwide! The game supports 12 major languages, with the PC version launching simultaneously on Steam and Epic Games Store.

[h2]EA Content Preview[/h2]
In the Early Access version of Netherworld Covenant, players can experience four complete chapters: Dungeons, Village, Coastal Fishing Hamlet, and Black Tower. Each chapter features unique terrains and distinct monster designs, with players encountering two Elite Bosses and one Final Chapter Boss per chapter. Defeating these powerful enemies grants substantial meta-progression rewards. Additionally, special encounters are scattered throughout the game—overcoming these challenges unlocks extra skills for your arsenal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/e590addc760ff1ce3251bd5810258a49135ed60d.jpg[/img]

[h2]Combat Dynamics Preview[/h2]
As an action roguelike, Netherworld Covenant challenges players to establish their combat systems through Main Weapons, Nether Lantern Weapons, and Ghost Skills. Nether Lantern Weapons provide unique "Suppression" effects to control enemy aggression, while Ghost Skills grant versatile abilities like Blocking, Ranged Attacks, AoE Bursts, and Mobility. However, these skills are governed by Energy and Stamina constraints respectively. Mastering the balance between resource management and offensive pressure will be the core tactical challenge in sustaining relentless attack rhythms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/89b8e812fbcf97f47ee6d13592e30d420c166dd9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Post-Launch Roadmap[/h2]
Following its Early Access launch, Netherworld Covenant will maintain consistent updates en route to its full 1.0 release. The development team plans to expand the game with new chapters, bosses, build archetypes, weapons, interactive elements, and world-building enhancements to deepen the dark fantasy experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010806/cab6f2716d6ac1849fe6b2c5e9688224c04763b0.jpg[/img]

[h2]Community Events[/h2]
During the Early Access launch period, we'll host community events like speedrun challenges—join us on [url=https://discord.gg/4ZwXCYS4ed]Discord[/url]

notes.title: New Demo Version Release Note
notes.notes:
This version is the final update before the February Next Fest version.

[h2]New Additions[/h2]
[h3]Multi-language Support[/h3]
- Added Turkish.
[h2]Out-of-Run Content[/h2]
1. Weapons
  - Three categories: Fast, Medium, and Slow, each with unique attack animations.
  - Unlockable weapons with various attributes.
2. Lamp Skills and "Suppress" Mechanic (Off-Hand Weapons)
  - Introduced 4 distinct Lamp Skills, enhancing offensive options and enabling stronger combos.
  - Use Lamp Skills to trigger Suppress and defeat powerful enemies.
3. Revamped General Enhancements
4. New "Manual" (Wiki)
  - Added a guide for in-game help and mechanics explanation.
5. Attack Alerts
  - Added alert types (Yellow, Red, and Crimson) to indicate interruptible attacks based on skill type.
6. Blueprint Unlocks
  - Amulets, weapons, and Lamp Skills can now be unlocked by collecting blueprints.
7. New Thief Skills
  - Time Rift: Actively slows time.
  - Knife Barrage: Launches a flurry of spinning knives, attacking enemies around you.
8. Boss Health Bar Enhancements
  - Added status effect indicators and an immunity alert for Resilience Damage.
9. Item Notifications
  - Added prompts for acquired items.
In-Game Content
1. Weapon Room Update
  - Replaced Weapon Rooms with Relic Rooms.
  - Players now have two Relic Slots. Relics provide multiple attributes, including a general effect and a passive skill enhancement.
2. Aura Adjustments
  - Rebalanced Auras and added new ones tied to Lamp Skills.
3. Black Stone Room Update
  - Converted into a non-combat room with an altar for replenishing Health Potions.

[h2]Adjustments and Fixes[/h2]
[h3]Gameplay Adjustments[/h3]
1. Sound Effects
  - Fixed low volume and disappearing audio issues.
2. Recall Ghost
  - Extended invincibility duration compared to Ethereal Walk, improving usability.
3. Ghost Skill Balancing
  - Adjusted balance and usability for several Ghost Skills.
4. Energy Gain Adjustment
  - Reduced energy gain from Melee Attacks; reallocated some to Lamp Skills.
5. Attack Alerts Timing
  - Alerts now appear earlier to give players more time to react with "Suppress."
6. Attack Detection Optimization
7. Wall Transparency
  - Improved semi-transparency for obstructed views.
8. Melee Attack Animation Improvements
9. Monster Turn Speed
  - Reduced to give players an advantage in backstabbing opportunities.
10. Time Stop Adjustment
  - Significantly weakened.
11. Block Skill
  - Easier to trigger.
12. Health Potions
  - Potions are consumed only when their effects are activated.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
1. Fixed issues causing bosses to freeze.
2. Resolved player positioning errors when appearing at incorrect map locations.
3. Improved scrolling functionality for lists.

notes.title: Development Progress and Upcoming Updates for "Netherworld Covenant"
notes.notes:
It's been a while since our store page launch. Today, I'd like to showcase some of the new features we've recently developed and discuss our plans for upcoming demo versions. We anticipate that the game will be available in Early Access this winter.

[previewyoutube=RCp9Cmzh83E;full][/previewyoutube]

Before the official release, we plan to launch two major demo versions (Demo1 and Demo2). 

[b]Demo1[/b] is expected to be released by the end of June. This version will primarily showcase the combat gameplay and some in-game progression, including 8 regular levels, 1 elite monster battle, and 1 boss battle.

[b]Demo2[/b] is expected to be released by the end of August. This version will further refine the combat and progression systems and introduce out-of-game progression features.

We are also seeking publishing partners for our game. If you are interested, please contact us via email at: madgoatgamestudio@gmail.com.
